scope: source-free synthetic development only; not source-independent scientific acceptance
research_role: Independent contributor; sole canonical coordinator is Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work PR1278
factual_source: NKR08 synthetic Q/P/Q staged in separate immutable candidate overlay; historical full TRAIN image read-only
causal_source: Separately generated explicitly revealed synthetic action-consequence tuples; NEVER Q/P/Q-as-outcome

per_seed.context_bit_from_source: 0 iff candidate has sole P910/P911 object base; 1 iff candidate has sole object base+1; unknown/ambiguous abstains
per_seed.modes: seeded balanced 32 zeros/32 ones per task; separately shuffled with seed*100+phase_index

candidate: existing yggdrasil.native_context_basis.NativeContextBasis(context_bits=1); A fits address 0, B fits address 1, max_degree=1, original unaccepted state untouched
controls: native context-blind majority by action with same witnessed interventions but no factual context
fully fitted conventional depth-two binary decision tree on the identical factual-context and action-outcome training rows
independently implemented exact symbolic conditional count lookup on identical rows
untrained fact lookup only; must not be claimed causal learning
frozen_primary_metric: Mean Brier loss of deterministic predicted reward across BOTH actions for all 32 cold entities of each world and each seed, 384 held action-outcome forecasts
additional_metrics: old A held-entity forecast bit-for-bit before and after B learning
correct action preference on held entities
exact historical base first/last lookup retention
new candidate fact retrieval and post-stage cold restoration
unavailable fact and conflicting Q/P/Q abstention
full-process elapsed time per source-matched arm

thresholds.engineering: complete input and source-pin checks, native >= 95% supported held predictions, 0 old-A readout changes, 0 historical source changes, exact cold restoration, no effect on original Amalgam bytes
thresholds.scientific: native mean held Brier at least 0.01 less than EACH equal-information fully trained conventional and exact symbolic control; no familiar return loss; disjoint original world required for independent acceptance
thresholds.interpretation: if native ties exact symbolic/tree, mark DEV_NO_GO for superiority despite source-use improvement versus context-blind

prohibited: source-outcome leakage from static Q/P/Q facts
reuse of this synthetic trial as independent benchmark
policy: one frozen run; no post-result threshold/seed tuning; preserve negatives; code source and suite dual OS then real original archive compatible job after both full regression
